policySource.text: Illustrative pilot uses 45 payment days, two approval levels, INR 10000 purchase approval threshold, 2 percent invoice tolerance and INR 50000 journal review threshold. These values demonstrate review and validation only.

activities.title: Payment terms
activities.crossRule: termCode day digits must match days

activities.title: Purchase approval thresholds
activities.crossRule: Currency must match selected demo company policy; proposer cannot be sole approver

activities.title: Journal review threshold
activities.crossRule: Finance approver required; no self approval

activities.title: Document number interval
activities.crossRule: start < end; no overlap; specialist review and attended recovery; no automatic rollback

activities.title: Company assignment reference
activities.crossRule: Referenced company must exist and have verified observation

activities.title: Company currency validation
activities.crossRule: Proposed currency cannot contradict organization; no legal currency change performed

activities.title: Purchasing responsibility
activities.crossRule: Selected plant and purchasing group must share permitted project scope

activities.title: Receipt control
activities.crossRule: Required receipt control cannot be disabled for the approved demo raw-material scenario

activities.title: Close task deadline
activities.crossRule: Illustrative working deadline only; no statutory reporting deadline inferred
